print_order.description: A print purchase: its immutable quote, buyer and originating app, exact document manifest and provider print specification.

print_paid.description: The authenticated platform payment receipt authorizing this print purchase.

print_submission.description: Durable submission intent written before contacting the printer. A lost response is reconciled by this reference; it is never blindly submitted again.

print_receipt.description: The provider's last authenticated print receipt. Its status is the provider's observation, preserved verbatim.

print_cancelled.description: The print job was confirmed cancelled or was stopped before submission.

print_refunded.description: The platform confirmed the buyer's refund.

print_absent.description: An operator confirmed that an uncertain submission created no provider order.

print_quote.description: The print specification and immutable artifact manifest priced by one server-owned service quote.

print_retry.description: An operator authorized one retry after investigating an uncertain submission and confirming absence at the printer.

print_cancel_denied.description: The provider observation that made cancellation unavailable. No refund was started.

print_document.description: An immutable prepared print document, inspected page previews and its exact file manifest.

print_service.description: PrintBound seller configuration. Preview mode simulates the printer and checkout without external calls or payments.

print_fixture.description: The persistent simulated provider receipt in a preview space.

print_preview_paid.description: A simulated preview purchase; no payment provider was contacted.

print_expired.description: The unpaid quote expired. A delayed verified payment can still restart merchant recovery.

print_payment_seen.description: This platform payment already scheduled print fulfillment.

print_payment_ready.description: A verified paid platform order restarts its print fulfillment, including late payment callbacks after quote expiry.

print_payment_blocked.description: A payment reversal observed before printing blocked a new supplier submission. Existing accepted supplier work remains recoverable.

print_preparation.description: A customer-scoped document preparation checkpoint and its originating app authority, resumed by bounded scheduled commands.

print_preparation_done.description: Document composition and inspection finished; print_document holds the immutable complete manifest.

print_preparation_failed.description: Preparation stopped while retaining the last complete checkpoint and all source work.
